protocol.role: development authored first-action transition veto on consumed changed states

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

rule.population: all jobs in each registered queue are visible at time zero; no future arrivals are generated

age_profiles.coincident: every visible job has age zero
age_profiles.unit_fifo: within each class, FIFO rank j has age (queue_count - 1 - j) times the one-second frame-duration floor

rule.baseline: v4 K26 first action followed by v4 K26 until complete drain
rule.variant: permutation-quotient K26 first action followed by v4 K26 until complete drain
rule.isolation: only the first action differs; both branches use the same continuation rule but may visit different queues
rule.fifo_execution: preserve raw option_indices order, then option coordinate and completion-offset order
rule.drain_bound: complete without truncation; each branch elapsed frame barriers must not exceed sum(queue) times the maximum model frame duration

fifo_pairing_fixture.expected: equal service, duration, score, completion-offset multiset, makespan, and mean; equal coincident sorted flows; unequal unit-FIFO nearest-rank P90

protocol.stopping_rule: run the frozen 16 states, two age profiles, and two arms once; advance only if all mean, tail, and nine-cell gates pass with a strict local and weighted gain; otherwise preserve the assigned stop reason without changing states, ages, K, continuation, tolerance, or drain rule
protocol.prohibited_in_this_stage: Poisson or other future arrivals, new states, age variants, repeated quotient decisions after the first frame, full trajectories, confirmation, and paper edits
protocol.interpretation: a conservative local transition veto; occurrence weights come from the frozen v4 trajectories and are not quotient-policy trajectory outcomes

specification.expected: equal service, duration, score, completion-offset multiset, makespan, and mean; equal coincident sorted flows; unequal unit-FIFO nearest-rank P90

next_step: close the quotient-cache branch without tuning or full trajectories
limitations: These authored finite drains are a conservative local veto, not full-policy trajectory evidence.
The unit-spaced FIFO ages use the model's one-second duration floor and do not estimate the empirical age distribution.
Occurrence weights come from frozen v4 K26 trajectories; they do not represent quotient-policy occupancy.
Only the first action uses the quotient selector; every continuation action is v4 K26.
